notes.title: Update 1.26 / The Palace
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27582949/1758898c8f2cb8af994c6813d362795749f4ff93.jpg[/img]
Release Note: October 2017

[list][*]Some new quests (Liraine, 1st part, quest to get leonigold clothes, quest for jellyfish eyes (requested by an emperator), quest leading to a new boss, Scarezen).
[*]New recipes (new tool for metascience: the runic sceptre, leonigold clothes (requested by an Emperator).
[*]New Plants (available at the Sword Cape, in some trade task and in fighting loots). You will be able to gather them normally when we open new areas.
[*]New bones.
[*]Correction of some problematic tasks.
[*]New guild building: the palace. This is a first version of this guild building (bone reinforcement, Kryamane ingot). We will add new tasks in the next updates.
[*]Modification of some loots on the Nessus, on the Masked Prowlers’ tasks and on the trade task at Eufelburg.
[*]New Achievements.
[*]You will get three membranes by craft now.
[*]Some other corrections.[/list]

The update will be done Monday morning in Quebec. Click on the following link to find out the schedule in your time zone: [url=https://www.worldtimebuddy.com/event?lid=2643743,360630,524901,6077243&h=2643743&sts=25114980&sln=14-20&a=show]WorldTimeBuddy[/url].

We wanted to do the update on Friday, however there are a few points, the achievements for example, which have not been updated for a long time. We decided to make the update at the beginning of next week to play it safe. However, the tests and the translations are finished and we continue to work on the next update.

[b]The game guide will be put online on 2017-09-28 so you can start preparing for the palace.[/b]

Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Steam Release Deal Extended
notes.notes:
To make up for our problems with the servers, we decided to keep our offer on the game shop until Friday night.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27582949/bef9bce0b8cc16626dd575c6795d7ffc2dbfdb51.png[/img]
The team is working hard to hunt down the remaining problems, do not hesitate to communicate with us if you have experiencing something wrong.
